name: kit
description: Meta-scaffolder for plugin repositories: one layout, one vendored generator and one shared CI for every stack, tool and utility plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Create and keep plugin repositories in one layout.
interface.longDescription: Creates stack, tool and utility plugin repositories in one shared layout, with the generator, CI and conformance files vendored from kit and pinned to a release.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a new plugin repository for a stack.
